newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's PRI concedes likely defeat in mayor's race.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's PRI concedes likely defeat in mayor's race.

text.p: Mexico's ruling Institutional Revolutionary Party's candidate for mayor of Mexico City, Alfredo del Mazo, conceded on live television that he was likely to lose the race in Sunday's elections.
"According to my party's quick count system, to now, we register a vote favouring the Party of the Democratic Revolution (PRD) and we are recognising that," del Mazo said.
Del Mazo was speaking after initial results showed the PRD's Cuauhtemoc Cardenas was likely to win a landslide victory in the elections for Mexico City mayor.
"I hope for success for Mr. Cardenas for the good of the city of Mexico City," del Mazo added.
Early official results from congressional elections showed President Ernesto Zedillo's party losing control of the lower house for the first time since the party was founded in 1929.
